name: Quill Prowler
lore: A brave porcupine who crouches into short springing bounds, then fights at claw distance. Mastery can exchange direct attacks for a pack of living quill companions.

primary.name: Briar Claw
primary.description: Close directional claw sweep: 24 damage, 85 reach.

secondary.name: Springthorn
secondary.description: A short collision-safe lunge; strike nearby foes for 22, push them back and briefly stun for 0.4s.

special.name: Bramble Stampede
special.description: Rush forward in three visible stages, hitting each enemy once for 42 damage and pushing them outward.

passive: Prickle Guard: a successful claw or lunge gives 10% damage reduction for 1s.

technique.name: Living Quills

attack.name: Living Quills
attack.description: Raise one 40-HP melee quill companion for 12s; cap three. Each deals 8 damage per 1.1s. Gives up the claw.

technique.description: Become a summoner instead of a direct primary fighter; three bounded companions.

final_technique.name: Quillpack Rally

attack.name: Quillpack Rally
attack.description: Fill your pack up to three companions and rally them to the aimed spot for 4s. Existing companions gain 30% protection for 4s, without free healing or lifetime refresh.

final_technique.description: Replace the stampede with summoning and pack positioning. Combine with Living Quills for a full summoner style.
